description: Mark an invoice cancelled. Reversible with restore_invoice, and the number stays in the series, which is what a tax authority expects of an issued document. Prefer this over delete_invoice. The invoice is read first: the answer says what it totalled (before), and with expect_total a call whose number names an invoice of another total changes nothing. Moves money or makes a legal document: the client asks the user to approve each call.

expect_total.description: The total the invoice must have ("121.00"); when it differs nothing is changed. Recommended: a number can name the wrong invoice.

number.description: The document number as text, without its series: "0042" is not 42.

series_name.description: The document's series, exactly as list_series shows it.

name: cancel_invoice
title: Cancel an invoice
